2610.12007.title: REACT: Rolling Denoising and Dual Decoupling for Reactive Robot Control with VLA Models
2610.12007.paper_summary: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models generate action chunks for temporally coherent robot motion, but chunked control creates a fundamental closed-loop trade-off: long chunks provide smooth execution, whereas frequent replanning improves reactivity at the cost of action discontinuities. We introduce REACT, a rolling-denoising framework that makes flow-based VLAs more reactive while preserving long-horizon context. Instead of regenerating entire action chunks from scratch, REACT maintains a persistent action buffer with staggered flow timesteps. At each control step, the full horizon is denoised using the latest observation, the cleanest action block is executed, partially refined future blocks are shifted forward, and fresh noise is appended to the tail. As a result, each executed action block is refined across multiple recent observations before deployment. To support real-time control, we further introduce dual decoupling, which separates sensing, VLM encoding, DiT denoising, and action execution, enabling high-frequency observation updates and action streaming under practical compute constraints. Across the RoboTwin 2.0 simulation benchmark and real-world tasks spanning bimanual manipulation and dynamic control on multiple robot platforms, REACT improves task success and reduces reaction latency while producing smoother trajectories than frequent-replanning and asynchronous baselines.
2610.12007.paper_summary_zh: 基於流的視覺-語言-行動（VLA）模型生成動作片段，以實現時間上連貫的機器人運動，但片段化控制創造了一個根本的閉環權衡：長片段提供平滑的執行，而頻繁的重新規劃則提高了反應能力，但以動作不連續為代價。我們引入了REACT，一個滾動去噪框架，使基於流的VLA在保持長期上下文的同時更加靈敏。REACT不是從頭生成整個動作片段，而是保持一個持久的動作緩衝區，具有錯開的流時間步。在每個控制步驟中，使用最新觀測值對整個時間範圍進行去噪，執行最乾淨的動作塊，部分精煉的未來塊向前移動，並將新噪聲附加到尾部。因此，每個執行的動作塊在部署之前會根據多個最近的觀測進行精煉。為了支持實時控制，我們進一步引入了雙重解耦，將感知、VLM編碼、DiT去噪和動作執行分開，從而在實際計算限制下實現高頻觀測更新和動作流。通過RoboTwin 2.0模擬基準和涵蓋雙手操作及多個機器人平台的動態控制的現實世界任務，REACT提高了任務成功率並減少了反應延遲，同時產生比頻繁重新規劃和異步基準更平滑的軌跡。
